===== help short

--loose        [string]          An ungrouped parameter. 
help message of that parameter will be printed. 
or `--helpFull`. 

Input/output options
  --input      [string] Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples. 
  --outdir     [string] The output directory where the results will be saved. 
  --report     [string] Report file. [default: ${params.outdir}/report.html] 
  --assets_dir [string] Assets folder. [default: ${projectDir}/assets] 

Generic options
  --mode       [string]          Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.  (accepted: symlink, rellink, link, copy, 
copyNoFollow, move) [default: copy] 
  --threads    [integer]         Number of threads. [default: 2] 
  --tool       [object]          Tool settings. (This parameter has sub-parameters. Use '--help tool' to see all sub-parameters) 
  --mixed      [string, integer] A value of two types.

===== help parameter input

--input
    type       : string
    format     : file-path
    exists     : true
    schema     : assets/schema_input.json
    mimetype   : text/csv
    pattern    : ^\S+\.csv$
    description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples.
== Top-level schema below ==
Title: probe samplesheet
Fields:
    reference  [string]   A reference text
    count      [integer] 
    sample     [string]   [required] (pattern: ^\S+$)
      Note: Sample name must not contain spaces
